C_reviewerSpecificAuthorizationModel: One immutable exact reviewer-token/organization/acting-unit/target-unit/subtype authorization with risk gates, scope/version/source version, start/end/revocation, issuer/evidence, policy, and governance approval reference for cross-unit authority. Live platform.capability.manage required to issue/revoke; general review permission is only a prerequisite.
D_crossUnitEnforcement: Same-unit default. Acting unit must match explicit grant. Distinct acting/target pair requires separate exact authorization and governance reference. No wildcard or cross-organization grants; sharing conveys no review authority.
E_approvalTimeRevalidation: Live account/session/TOTP, role, membership, both units, reviewer authorization, verification, attestation, subtype/hazard/closure grants and governed scope/version are checked before receipt replay and again before approval commit; atomic failure and no grace period.
F_staleRevisionApprovalEnforcement: Candidate identity/revision and caller details revision plus immutable source/detail/impact/linked-source/contract/policy/scope state digest must match current state. Audit records exact tokens, source/detail/candidate revisions, impact revision vector, state digest, policy versions and server timestamp. Changed source needs new candidate; withdrawal removes eligibility immediately.
G_schemaChangesRequired: YES: two additive forced-RLS private tables and four additional publication-review columns; six private helpers and two narrow commands
